verdicts.reason: A: the oversized logo block is as loud as the watch, so the brand outweighs the product. The 'Field Watch No. 2' name is small and sits under the watch. The $420 price is stranded bottom-left, away from 'Free engraving' and Shop on the right, so the group is broken up and the bottom row feels cramped and arbitrary. B: a clean, centred stack keeps the product → price → CTA flow, but the price now sits above the product name (the order is swapped). The logo has shrunk to a tiny bottom-left corner mark whose MONOGRAPH/GALLERY wordmark is illegible, and wide empty side margins make the layout look like a narrow column dropped into a square.
